evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear. Small intrasubstance ganglion formation at the tibial insertion.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Complex tear with dominant radial component at the posterior root.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Confluent regions of high-grade articular cartilage loss at both sides of the weightbearing aspect of the joint
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity and high-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage loss at the patella, including areas of full-thickness cartilage loss
